name: cortex-mcp-server

tools.name: search_knowledge
tools.description: Search 728 knowledge fragments across 26 domains for validated patterns, skill procedures, and implementation examples. Use before writing code, designing architecture, or reviewing work to ground your approach in battle-tested practices.

tools.name: get_fragment
tools.description: Retrieve the full content of a specific knowledge fragment by ID (e.g. SKL-0001, PAT-0042). Use after search_knowledge returns relevant results and you need the complete procedure, pattern, or example.

tools.name: browse_library
tools.description: List all available knowledge fragments, optionally filtered by category (skills, patterns, agents, examples) or domain pillar (e.g. game-dev, ecommerce). Use to discover what knowledge exists before searching.

category.description: Category to browse, or 'all' for everything (default: all)

tools.name: detect_project
tools.description: Analyze a list of project root filenames to detect the tech stack and suggest relevant knowledge searches. Use at project start to auto-scope knowledge to the right domains.

files.description: List of filenames in the project root (e.g., package.json, requirements.txt, Cargo.toml)

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Show all categories and domain pillars with fragment counts. Use to understand library coverage and available filtering options.

tools.name: search_metrics
tools.description: View diagnostic search metrics: query counts, tier resolution rates, zero-result frequency, and top-10 most retrieved fragments. Use to understand search quality and inform optimization decisions.
